inputs.body:
Cell{
  since: {{timestamp timepoint: absolute timestamp ≥ finalized ts}},
  capacity: W,
  lock: WITHDRAWAL_LOCK(rollup_type_hash ‖ args ‖ owner_lock),
  type: null | sUDT,
  data: …
}

boxes.body:
code cell (see deployments)
// needed by CKB to run the script

label.zh: cell_dep：rollup cell + RollupConfig（区块号 timepoint 时）

boxes.body:
rollup cell (type hash = rollup_type_hash; may be an input instead) → GlobalState
RollupConfig by data hash → is_finalized()

label.zh: args = rollup_type_hash ‖ WithdrawalLockArgs（104B struct）‖ owner_lock_len（u32 BE）‖ owner_lock（Script）
label.en: args = rollup_type_hash ‖ WithdrawalLockArgs (104B struct) ‖ owner_lock_len (u32 BE) ‖ owner_lock (Script)

role.zh: 包含该提款的 L2 区块
L1 收款 lock 脚本

cond.zh: 长度 ≥ 32+104+4，owner_lock 长度吻合，hash = owner_lock_hash
cond.en: length ≥ 32+104+4; owner_lock length matches; hash = owner_lock_hash

cond.zh: rollup cell（deps 或 inputs）存在且已终结
cond.en: rollup cell (deps or inputs) exists and finalized

cond.zh: since 为绝对时间戳且 ≥ timepoint
cond.en: since is an absolute timestamp ≥ timepoint

cond.zh: 每个同 lock 输入 i：output[i] capacity / data / type 相同且 lock = owner_lock；否则需 owner 输入
cond.en: each same-lock input i: output[i] same capacity / data / type and lock = owner_lock; else an owner input

boxes.body:
Cell{ data: RollupConfig (molecule) }
// load_rollup_config(): found by {{data hash == GlobalState.rollup_config_hash}} → else 10

cond.zh: 输出有 rollup cell 且动作为 SubmitBlock，回滚列表含 withdrawal_block_hash
cond.en: a rollup output whose action is SubmitBlock and whose reverted list contains withdrawal_block_hash

cond.zh: 有 lock hash = custodian_lock_hash 的输出；args[0..32] = rollup_type_hash
cond.en: an output with lock hash = custodian_lock_hash; args[0..32] = rollup_type_hash

cond.zh: code_hash = config.custodian_script_type_hash，type，block hash 与 timepoint 为 0，内容相同
cond.en: code_hash = config.custodian_script_type_hash, type, zero block hash and timepoint, same content

notes.zh: ⚠ 状态：官方已宣布 Godwoken 退役（2025-06-01 起，Nervos Talk “Sunset of Force Bridge and Godwoken”）；冻结期限延至 2026-01-01 23:59:59 UTC，之后网络冻结、桥前端下线，v0/v1 RPC 节点已关闭。本页仅作历史 / 审计参考。
notes.en: ⚠ Status: Godwoken was officially sunset (from 2025-06-01, Nervos Talk “Sunset of Force Bridge and Godwoken”); the freeze deadline was extended to 2026-01-01 23:59:59 UTC, after which the network froze, the bridge UI went offline and v0/v1 RPC nodes were shut down. This page is for historical / audit reference.
